title: Tatrman layout (format 1)
description: One named picture of a schema: the cards it shows and, optionally, where they sit. The YAML serialization of the Tatrman layout document; the same document is also written as a TTR `.ttrg` graph block. See https://docs.tatrman.org/model/layout-files/ and the shared test vectors in layout-vectors/.

layout.description: The format version. A reader that meets a higher version refuses the file: "layout format N is newer than this reader".

name.description: The layout's name — the `.ttrg` graph-name rule; a writer also uses it as the file stem.

model.description: The schema the cards come from. `md` and `cnc` are admitted, untested.

objects.description: The cards shown — entities (er), tables and views (db). A writer lists full qnames, sorted by code point; a reader resolves any form the resolution rule accepts.

positions.description: Manual positions, keyed by a ref that is also in `objects`. Absent or empty means auto layout.

collapsed.description: Reserved: carried, not acted on in format 1.

objectRef.description: A model object: a full qname `<pkg>.<qname>` (`hartland.er.entity.item`, `hartland.db.dbo.item`), or a shorter form the resolution rule accepts (`er.entity.item`, `entity.item`, `item`).
